findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward is an endpoint pointcloud view over predicted endpoint world coordinates, so coordinate contrasts are selection/attention evidence rather than physical interaction energies.

The observed learning window is [0.0,0.5] with score nodes every 0.01 and curve support [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior is used, so no absolute affinity target is available in the supplied evidence.

Continuous contrast features at landmark_00 show non-monotone behavior across the observed support: e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass has 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts; a constant rule is not supported by these observed-node linear fits.

Several landmark_00 local derivative features (dy, dz, cxx, cyy) also show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts with no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation allowed, indicating that time-conditioned rather than constant contrast rules are better supported within the observed window only.

hypotheses.falsifier: A constant rule matches or exceeds the time-conditioned rule on observed-node fit fidelity without additional sign conflicts.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00 soft-mass and local-dx contrast sign and rate over observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule using validated observed-node interpolation over [0.0,0.49] will better track the sign-changing landmark_00 contrasts than a constant rule, without extrapolation beyond the observed support.

hypotheses.falsifier: Joint diagnostics show no coupling and marginals remain independently informative.
hypotheses.observable: joint diagnostics and covariance among landmark_00 features
hypotheses.statement: Isolated marginal landmark_00 descriptors may be redundant or coupled; joint coordinate patterns should be checked against supplied covariance/joint diagnostics before being treated as independent evidence.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or current-study outcome data are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Selection enrichment versus absolute geometric descriptors cannot be separated without the population/label/observable binding tables, which were not read in this turn.
Uncertainty, multiplicity-adjusted support and coverage rankings were not retrieved, so no concrete priority decision differing from point estimates alone is asserted.
Turnover residual and parent-child increment contrasts were not read; within-path change versus cohort composition change remains unresolved.
No temperature edit is proposed or permitted; temperatures are immutable task parameters.
